field.encoding: F_25 = F_5[x]/(x^2 + x + 2); the int e = sum_{i<2} c_i 5^i (0 <= c_i < 5) is the element sum_i c_i x^i
field.modulus_choice: lexicographically first primitive monic polynomial of degree m over F_p (qlib GF)

generator: [I_6 | A] over F_25, rows = basis of the Hermitian self-dual code C

structure.description: Bevins-Bidav A_5 (arXiv:2608.05781), the printed 6 x 6 matrix
structure.rule: a printed label e (0 <= e < 25) is the element (e mod 5) + (e div 5) r, r a root of the printed minimal polynomial x^2 + x + 2 (transcription: work/couple/lib.py ame12_5, work/auditor/bb_kernel.py); r = x = int 5 here, because x^2 + x + 2 is also the modulus, so the printed labels and the ints of this file coincide
